scope: Reporting this frozen supplied-state extrapolation campaign; not an architecture-only comparison or hardware safety validation.
method: Independent read-only reconstruction from saved arrays and source. No forecasts, model calls, writes or use of the parent analysis functions as a calculator.

integrity.post_rollout_parameter_checks: Worker fingerprint assertions passed. Final live parameter tensors were not separately saved for independent post-hoc tensor hashing.

common_qualified_cohort.metric: Mean per-path RMSE; values rounded to five decimal places.
common_qualified_cohort.limitation: Selected by numerical completion; not representative full-suite evidence.

adapter_failure_attribution.stage: Existing-network current-to-flux inversion, before candidate initialization or upstream solving.
adapter_failure_attribution.evidence: All terminal searches have finite negative residuals throughout four sampled windows and no root candidate.
adapter_failure_attribution.interpretation: Bounded-search exhaustion, not global nonexistence of a root.

consistency_failure_interpretation: Both paths initialized correctly and stayed finite until upstream fsolve reported insufficient progress over its last five Jacobian evaluations. These are propagation-time failures despite the generic initial-algebraic-states exception. Records do not establish Jacobian singularity, absence of a solution, or a uniquely identified learned-law cause.

diagnostic_logging_caveat.stale_origin: Previous successful 50-percent case for the same attachment; candidate initialization was not attempted.
diagnostic_logging_caveat.instruction: For all 80 adapter-entry failures, use fresh adapter_records.actual and traceback only. Do not interpret adapter_records.candidate as a new attempt.
diagnostic_logging_caveat.scientific_effect: No effect on forecasts, outcomes or decision counts. Frozen code and raw records are preserved unchanged.

limitations: Existing training data and budgets differ across methods.
All five saved fits and all failures are retained; no target tuning or corrected model variants.
Failed or incomplete pairs abstain and receive no decision credit.
Thresholds are synthetic task screens, not hardware ratings or safety guarantees.
The campaign forecasts from assigned connected states, not a physical switch-closing transient.
